description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Edits a CTA, its status or its goal fields (goalKey, isPrimary, paidEligible, adButton). New copy or a new destination is claims-checked again; a CTA whose claims block cannot be approved. Free. Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/hook-studio/ctas.)

adButton.description: The ad button. Default: the ads config default CTA.

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

destination.description: An https link, or "bio" for the link in bio.

goalKey.description: The goal this CTA serves, a short slug such as `tech-checkup`.

isPrimary.description: The brand's primary goal. Setting it demotes the previous primary.

paidEligible.description: Ads may use this CTA. Default: true for a primary, false otherwise.

name: ctas_update
title: Update a CTA
